description: A callable applied at definition time: `@dec` above `def f` means `f = dec(f)`.
The inner function a decorator returns; it runs on every call and usually calls the original.
Copies `__name__`, `__qualname__`, `__doc__`, `__module__` and annotations onto the wrapper and sets `__wrapped__`.
A reference to the original function; `inspect.signature` and `inspect.unwrap` follow it.
Decorators apply bottom-up, and their wrappers run top-down at call time.
